AE-08 phase 9 packaged confirmation (hand record, no --bless). Covers 69281e45 (the renderer mark names are a zod enum: packages/desktop-protocol/src/ipc-channels.ts, apps/desktop/ae08-evidence.ts, src/lib/desktop/ae08-marks.ts, tools/acceptance/ae-08-phase-9-matrix.ts) and the confirmation worker's changes.

Product: (1) src/hooks/useTimelinePlayback.ts: an adoption a locate (seek) ended while its publication was under way ran no more, because the Play recorded the edit's fingerprint as applied and nothing followed; the request now runs again against the moved transport when the adoption answers superseded and a locate happened during it (witness: useTimelinePlayback.test.ts 'adopted snapshot seek-inflight preserves the latest live intent', red before the change: no publication followed the seek). The packaged open-editor row failed 1 run in 5 to 3 in 8 on that path ('no publication-complete line within 15000 ms'); 15 consecutive runs after it passed. The controller's contract that a seek ends a publication (LAT1 3 witnesses) is unchanged. (2) apps/desktop/audio-host.ts: opt-in evidence only, a schedule-window line (revision and the lane events of each window) beside the existing evidence lines; nothing runs with the evidence channel off.

Oracle: tools/acceptance/ae-08-latency-gates.ts: the lead gate judges only a publication that stages schedule windows against its revision (a latency publication, a plug-in's own latency report, binds no seam: it prepares with no requested frame and native publishes at the next block boundary, so its lead is 0 by design; the gate had only been certified on seam-bound publications). Evidence with no schedule-window line judges every lead as before. Self-test: 3 new synthetic cases, 25 cases and 2 negative controls pass; rc-p5c/phase5 still PASS (16 publications). ae-08-phase-9-rows/matrix/compare: manual-automation-override settles knob-drag on a publication whose schedule windows carry no lane event and lane-rearm on a publication whose windows carry it, and judges both on those windows (judge lane, settle lane and lane-free). ae-08-phase-9-devices/launch: the launch records the input device list (native-input-device) when a recording row selects BlackHole.

Checks: useTimelinePlayback 257 pass, 2 fail (the 2 known reds); controller test unchanged, 685 pass at the last full run; apps/desktop 431 pass; typecheck exit 0; tools typecheck no new errors (101 known); oxlint on the changed files 0 warnings, 0 errors; matrix, compare, launch, devices, live-graph and latency-gates self-tests pass. The 511 non-search, non-retired arms whose targets, witnesses or fuzz sources include a changed file were run with --only --jobs 1 in three chunks: 171/171 PASS, 171 PASS and 1 FAIL, 171/171 PASS. The one failure, arm:ledger:482:mutant:playback, is SIGALRM at its 400 s limit: its mutant (followPortableEdits removed) makes every adopted-snapshot test wait out its 30 s timeout, and the same mutant on this tree with the change above removed takes 423 s, so it exceeds the limit without it; the arm passed in a later full run. A later run of the full 892-job set with --jobs 1 (an --only list that was empty) passed 878 jobs and failed 14, none in the changed code paths: hook fuzz compileCount above the recorded ceiling (seeds 18, 30, 33, 202, 319, 664, 667 and the two traces; the drift record 42 documents and attributes to before 4c37bd9a), x-wasm-artifact and x-wasm-source-hash (the wasm artifact, not touched), g-tools-typecheck, f-cost-browser, rc1-i11-cost-browser and last-buffer (the known B25 and B29b reds), and the two controller trace campaigns ('gate.json was not written').
